title: Chapter 527
paragraphs: Chapter 527
Episode 144. For a Friend (5)
Enemies were taking positions everywhere. The knights on guard were tirelessly reporting the size and movements of the enemy.
"Activate the defensive equipment!"
"Helter, draw your sword!"
"Ropermo, support the rear. Regroup!"
Woong-!

The defensive artifacts installed in the Sword Emperor's Castle were activated, creating vibrations and resonant sounds. The blue protective shield of the artifacts and the white sword shield spread by the knights instantly enveloped the entire Sword Emperor's Castle.
Dante was looking at the reinforcements that appeared at the main gate.
At least 5,000 knights and wizards, about 20 dragons. And more than 50 cannons, each at least of the Emperor Dragon class.
Although the Empire is said to be lagging behind even Kinzelo, despite claiming to be an "Empire", being overshadowed by Runcandel and Zipfel.
No one denies that Vermont is one of the four major forces. Leaving aside the quality of the troops, the Empire was the only force that could mobilize so many people for war in such a short time.
Dante's eyes darkened with life as he looked at the Imperial Army.
Even though the army of tens of thousands was besieging the Sword Emperor's Castle, neither Dante nor the knights of Hairan lost their spirit.
Since the appearance of knights and wizards in the world, the number of soldiers has never been the most important factor in human warfare.
Before a superhuman, common knights of 5-star or less are no different from fallen leaves, no matter how many there are.

Although Dante was not yet a superhuman, he had a sword equivalent to one. Along with the other knights of Hairan, including the Five Sword Saints, suppressing the numerous common knights was not a difficult task.
What mattered were the enemy commanders. If all the knights and wizards who could shake the battlefield alone were cut down, they could win even if outnumbered.
And Dante estimated that there would be about a hundred of such figures.
The main force of the Imperial Army at the main gate was entering the plains.
Among them, there was a huge cannon led by five dragons and about a hundred knights.
"Small house owners, that is……!"
The main cannon of the Imperial Royal Guard.

The 'Dragon Spear', the Emperor's exclusive war equipment, which exists only one in the Empire. The cannon originally installed in the center of the Imperial Palace had a power comparable to the cannon of Zipfel's decisive weapon, Kozak.
Since the Dragon Spear was removed from the Imperial Palace, it could not fully exert its original power.
However, the appearance of the Dragon Spear meant that the Emperor had personally stepped forward.
"Dragon Spear loading confirmed!"

The voices of the knights looking at the Dragon Spear were trembling. It was only a matter of time before even the Emperor Dragon-class cannon could penetrate the partially recovered defensive artifacts of the Sword Emperor's Castle, but the Dragon Spear was on a completely different level.
Dante silently looked behind the Dragon Spear.
Somewhere beyond the plains, he seemed to see the figure of the emperor sitting in a sedan, waiting for the victory report with a face soaked in greed and arrogance.
"Small house owner! The Dragon Spear... you need to avoid it!"
"To them."
Dante slowly drew his sword.
Chiing...!

The moment Dante's sword was enveloped in a light, the ominous noise from the Dragon Spear engulfed the battlefield. A minor earthquake occurred in the entire area, and those in battle momentarily turned their gaze towards the Dragon Spear.
"I will show you the dignity of Hairan."
Kwaaaa-!
The Dragon Spear spewed out a giant magic bullet. The place where the shell was flying was precisely where Dante was standing on the castle wall.
The layers of protective shields of the artifacts shattered like glass.
Those who have not reached the realm couldn't follow the fast speed of the Dragon Spear's shell with their eyes, it seemed as if it would destroy the Sword Emperor's Castle in a single hit.
Dante didn't avoid it.
He swung his sword at the moment when the Dragon Spear's shell had come close to his face.
Imperial Sword Technique
Heavenly Slash - Dante Hairan
The Dragon Spear's bullet was split in half.
Even the knights standing right next to him didn't notice the moment Dante swung his sword.
They only confirmed that the split bullet followed the trajectory of Dante's sword swing and disappeared into the sky.
And as the name of the technique implies, a long, shining sword mark remained in the darkening sky.
Everyone on the battlefield looked up at that light for a moment.
Hairan's sword, which everyone in the Empire looked up to, was right there.
For a few seconds, there was silence as if time had stopped. Those standing on the battlefield only felt their own heartbeat.
Awe.
Thinking of the two words that Hairan symbolizes in the Empire.
Waaaa-!

The knights gathered under the banner of Hairan shouted in unison. Then, as Dante jumped off the castle wall and stepped onto the plains, the approaching enemies hesitated and stopped their movements.
"I have no intention of showing mercy to those who have forgotten their honor. So if you're scared, run away. Hairan will not chase those who retreat."
Knights gathered behind Dante.
"Small house owner... Are you okay?"
The assault captain looked at Dante's face and spoke. Blood was flowing from between his blue lips. But Dante nodded his head as if feeling rather light.
'Even though it's a technique that my grandfather improved for me, I'm in this state just from using it once.'
Everyone was in awe, but Dante knew better than anyone that the real power of Heavenly Slash wasn't comparable to what he had demonstrated.
He was regretful.
Not because he couldn't demonstrate a better sword technique, but he suddenly felt regretful that he could no longer strive on this land with his grandfather, Hairan's knights, and his relatives.
'I feel light for some reason...'
Perhaps it was because he was prepared to die, carrying everything his ancestors and grandfather had built and protected on his back, Dante had now entered a kind of awakening state.
Until the end of the war, he felt like he could maintain his best swordsmanship at the cost of his life.
"I will destroy the Dragon Spear first. I will break through at the forefront, so the assault team, follow me."
At the moment when Hairan's knights began their charge, the Emperor was receiving real-time reports of all situations from the farthest back of the battlefield.
"Oh, oh...! As expected, it's the successor of General Ron, truly impressive!"
Standing next to the Emperor was John Cena Ferrell, the commander of the Emperor's Dragon King Knights and the overall commander of the Emperor's Army. Unlike the excited Emperor, his face was dark.
Kevin Ferrell, the Emperor appointed him as the commander of the vanguard for the exact reason of John Cena Ferrell.
This stubborn man thought that the death of a blood relative was necessary to alleviate the guilt of the Empire's Jai Sword.
"You must have heard the report just now, General John Cena Ferrell. Dante Hairan killed your brother and slaughtered the knights who were trying to keep faith in Hairan..."
John Cena nodded heavily.
He is no fool.
He knew why the Emperor put his brother in the vanguard, and he knew that Dante would not have killed the knights, and how unjust this retaliation was. John Cena was not ignorant.
"I clearly gave Hairan a chance. But what came back was your brother's head and a betrayal of faith, if we don't finish it today, that poisoned wolf will push the entire empire into death and fear."
Yet the reason John Cena followed the Emperor was because it was for the Empire, no. More precisely, it was for the people of the Empire.
"Your Majesty."
"Speak, General John Cena."
"Keep your promise. Also, make sure they keep their promise..."
At those words, the Emperor smiled broadly.
"I will definitely do so!"
As John Cena stood up and headed towards the battlefield, the Emperor waved his hand at his back. And as soon as John Cena disappeared, he erased his expression.
Dante and the knights of Hairan were already covered in blood and moving towards the Dragon Spear. That blood was from the knights who had thrown their bodies to stop them.
All the knights of the main force, except for the vanguard, believed that Dante had killed the knights who were trying to keep faith with Hairan.
In the cruel and harsh battle, there was no time to correct misunderstandings and clarify the truth.

The rescued hundred or so knights could not survive in the pouring swordplay and magic. In the new battle that started as soon as the main force arrived, Hairan's knights did not have the strength to take them all. The main force had arrived sooner than expected.
In the eyes of the imperial army's main force, it appeared as though Hairan had indiscriminately massacred the vanguard.

If disobeying the emperor's command meant death, and fighting against Hairan also meant death, they would rather choose the latter. This was to avoid a future where they would be branded as traitors and have their entire families executed.
Blood and war create madness. The common knights who chose madness over fear were just trying to meet death in a single blow, blocking Dante's way.
Dante, who was cutting them down, was no different.
Integrity.
The word that summarized the humanity of the character called Dante was stained dark red.
'How many have I cut down already?'
Even as a sudden doubt struck him, Dante's sword was cutting through the necks of those who charged at him. Although the guilt heavier than blood was weighing him down, he was unable to realize it.
Like most who are swept up in war.
Dante was naturally substituting this huge guilt with hatred.
'I can't go back now. My family, my ancestors, and I, have never betrayed the empire. Why are you trying to stab us...?'
Dante paused for a breath when there were about five hundred steps left to the spear. Until then, the assault team following Dante was in a completely safe state.
However, the moment they tried to advance again, someone infiltrated their side.
"Ugh!"
"Block it!"
The golden armor, it was the Imperial Guards. As soon as they appeared, they cut down two knights of Hairan who were at the rear.
Dante blankly stared at the dead Hairan knights for a moment.
"You are a devil, Dante Hairan. Was all of your past just hypocrisy? I didn't know you were so accustomed to killing innocent people... Hmph!"
Dante dashed at him like an arrow and thrust his sword. He showed no surprise and parried the blow, but his arm was cut off as soon as Dante increased his speed.
The knights of the Imperial Guards, who had entered the scene in high spirits, had no choice but to flinch at the sight.
The knight whom Dante had maimed in just a few seconds was their third squadron leader.
"Shut up. I have nothing to say to trash like you."
Dante cut off the 3rd squadron leader's neck and said in a cold voice.
"You bastard, ugh!"
"Dante, we'll take care of this. Go to the spear!"
Without any hesitation, Dante left the knights of Hairan behind and moved forward.
He fully realized that if he hesitated even a little, more of the Hairan knights would die faster.
Also, he felt that he could hold onto his sanity, which was on the verge of madness, only if he kept cutting down those who blocked his path and moved forward.
